evidence_slice: Exeter City Council's official Planning Committee HTML record for 29 June 2015 contains item 47, Planning Application No. 15/0185/03, for land to the rear of the former Crawford Hotel, Alphington Road, Exeter. The record directly evidences the building identity and former hotel use, but the selected HTML record publishes no record-bound Polygon/MultiPolygon coordinates or downloadable physical building-footprint geometry. No geometry was inferred from the application context or linked material.
